title: RBA holds official interest rate at 3.6% while warning of rising house prices and rents
summary: Reserve Bank’s decision to leave cash rate on hold was widely expected and major banks predict no interest rates cut until 2026 Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The Reserve Bank has left the official interest rate on hold, as it warned house prices and rents will rise in 2026 after a surprise rebound in inflation. title: Almost 120 flying foxes hospitalised after giant hail smashes Queensland colony
